proposals.title: Get Joey Donuts eligible for top 100!
proposals.tldr: Hey everyone! My name is Joey “Joey Donuts” Farah , and I’ve been competing in Super Smash Bros. Melee since 2016 . Over the years, I’ve dedicated countless hours to supporting my local scene as a TO and helping fellow Falcos improve…
proposals.content:
Hey everyone!

My name is **Joey “Joey Donuts” Farah**, and I’ve been competing in** **Super Smash Bros. Melee since **2016**. Over the years, I’ve dedicated countless hours to **supporting my local scene as a TO** and helping fellow Falcos improve through **savestates, lessons, and content**. Now, I’m asking for your support to help me accomplish my goal of** breaking into the top 100.**

### WHY ME?

I only need ONE more large event attended to become eligible for the top 100 rankings in 2025!

Some previous notable results include **25th at Riptide 2025,** **33rd at Supernova 2025, 65th at DPOTG 2024 and 25th at LTC 2021 **and consistent **top 50 finishes on the Slippi leaderboard**. The IRL attendance has earned me wins on **SDJ, Eve, Ingenn, Lexor, Maher, HPR and more!**

If you enjoyed any of my content online like my [Combo like a Slippi top 50 GM Falco](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GLRdMP5NBEc) and its [Analysis](https://youtu.be/0XJFSO7nhro?si=XA_rqcMftcJGXYQa) or sniping Moky on unranked and want to see me in action at an IRL event, please consider supporting! Your vote would mean the world to me.

- Joey Donuts

**Sup guys! Trif here 💅**

I’ve been competing in Melee for over 15 years and not only myself but almost all of the top players consider me the biggest grinder in the world 🚬
Right now I’m considered the best Peach in the world, the best in Europe, and the best player outside of North America, overperforming my seeding 90% of the time 💥
I’m known for having nerves of steel built on patience, creativity, and consistency. I’ve proven I can go toe to toe with the best players in the world and make sets that people actually want to watch, with results like getting 2nd at Genesis X2. I’ve put in years of solo grinding and I’m ready to bring all that work to Fast Fall$ while also trying to qualify for the next event in Japan 💚

proposals.content:
**My Proposal**

MOF here, South Florida Ice Climbers specialist.

You may recognize me from the Lil Nouns do anything round where I became a player for and represented LIL Nouns at GOML 2025, a write-up/recap of which I gave here  [Link](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aCnmBnPk3v69_h-4RzoL6jbSL-XfCwV5Tn7NSVM4AfQ/edit?tab=t.0)

and I hope to be able to rep LIL at another event (possibly 2 if I make it to Japan after ;3)

**Why Vote for me?**

Well a few reasons, first off, I was awfully close to qualifying for the Japan Nounsvitational at Nouns Bowl, placing 4th but by a extremely unlikely chance was still not in the top 2 placings for the spot. I look to correct that and get what was snubbed for me at Fast Fall$ where there are 2 Tokyo spots on the line. Get yourself a player to represent in both New York and Tokyo. Secondly, I am an active member in the LIL Nouns DAO voting on proposals as well as active in the nounsgg ecosystem constantly voting, entering Nouns Doubles events etc. I am familiar with how things work and believe I am rather qualified to represent LIL at Fast Fall$.

**Fufilling player requirements and then some**

Aside from doing the bare minimum player requirements I will also make sure to post about attending the event/repping LIL on multiple other platforms (Farcaster, Bluesky), do a similar write-up to my GOML 2025 progress report, join LIL voice calls leading up to and after the event, etc.

**I hope you consider voting for me, thank you for your time.**

**Farcaster: **[https://farcaster.wyz/mast3rofflavor](https://farcaster.wyz/mast3rofflavor)

proposals.tldr: I have been playing competitive melee for around 11 years. Dedicated ness main who loves to pk thunder and yoyo glitch :). I have trained with netplay and in IRL tournaments in LA, CO, and NC. (I have moved around quite a lot in my…
proposals.content:
I have been playing competitive melee for around 11 years. Dedicated ness main who loves to pk thunder and yoyo glitch :). I have trained with netplay and in IRL tournaments in LA, CO, and NC. (I have moved around quite a lot in my lifetime.)

I have a few _okay _wins here and there: some state PR wins. I would love the chance to play against the top talent of melee on CRT setups instead of stream sniping them during their unranked self-imposed challenges :P.

I know its a long shot, but I gotta shoot my shot. I believe I have a decent chance against some of the weirder MUs, such as DK, Yoshi, and ICs. This is due to their lack of MU knowledge and experience as well as my own performance against these characters.

If by some miraculous wave of support I am selected, my gratitude from the community will skyrocket my motivation to the **moon**. Following selection, I will train within the nesscord heavily until the event date! I'll also pay for a coaching lesson with KirbyKaze if he is available :D.

I'm confident that I can create memorable moments during Nounsvitational if selected :)
Here is just one magical moment I have created so far: [Link](https://x.com/NotAklo/status/1469128820108283908)

Shoutouts to Aklo for shouting me out way back when. 

Cheers yall, hope everyone is doing well. Take care, peace <3.
